name: hcapp_getTrackImports
description: The caller's track-import jobs (E5.F5.S7). With @jobId: that one job in full (result JSON and blob URL), only if it is theirs. Without: their latest 20 without the JSON. Also used by ProcessTrackImport to authenticate and scope the job it works on. Auth: HC6.ValidateAppAuth (spNumber 97, @param NULL); rows are the caller's own (HasherId = @userId). Runtime errors are logged to HC.ErrorLog and re-thrown.

parameters.name: jobId
parameters.description: One job, or NULL for the list.

rowsets.name: ErrorEnvelope
rowsets.description: On auth failure only (ValidateAppAuth): { success=0, errorCode, errorType }, paired with StandardErrorResult at index 1. Mutually exclusive with Jobs.
Paired with ErrorEnvelope on auth failure. Not present on success.

rowsets.name: Jobs
rowsets.description: With @jobId: zero or one row (the job, only if HasherId = @userId; a deleted job is still returned). Without: the caller's latest 20 jobs with DeletedAt NULL, ORDER BY UploadedAt DESC, blobUrl and resultJson NULL.

columns.name: blobUrl
columns.description: Single-job form only; NULL in the list.

columns.name: kind
columns.description: 0 unknown · 1 gpx · 2 tcx · 3 fit · 4 zip (set by the processor).

columns.name: nextIndex
columns.description: Activities before this index are done.

columns.name: skippedCount
columns.description: Everything not imported and not held.

columns.name: resultJson
columns.description: Single-job form only: {activities:[{i,name,format,sport,startUtc,endUtc,lat,lng,points,distanceM,outcome,eventId,eventName,kennelName,candidates,error}]}. Every activity found, matched or not.

sideEffects: INSERT HC.ErrorLog from the CATCH block (lines 77-79, after ROLLBACK)

codeSmells.detail: @deviceId and @accessToken (lines 2-3) have no SQL default. A client that omits either gets 'expects parameter' — an unlogged empty 500 before the SP runs — instead of ValidateAppAuth's logged auth error.
The SP sets SET NOCOUNT ON only. Harmless for a read with no transaction, but inconsistent with the HC6 SP standard, which requires both.
Lines 55-62 return a job by id whether or not DeletedAt is set, while the list at line 72 hides deleted jobs; a client polling a job it just deleted keeps seeing it.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
